newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Heng Fung directors lobby shareholders.
newsitem.headline: Heng Fung directors lobby shareholders.

text.p: Two directors of Heng Fung Holdings Co Ltd have written to shareholders ahead of an extraordinary meeting at which the company will seek to have them removed from the board.
"The reasons provided by the company for removing us as directors are totally unjustified," wrote Ng Mok-yuen and Leung Sik-keung in a letter to shareholders published on Tuesday.
Ng and Leung said they had rejected a request from Heng Fung's solicitors on April 29 to resign, and Heng Fung had called an extraordinary meeting on May 27 to seek their removal.
"With your support, we will continue to pursue your interest," Ng and Leung wrote in the letter to shareholders.
Heng Fung's chairman, Chan Heng-fai, said the company was involved in litigation with Ng and Leung, but expected to issue a statement later in the day.
